title: Impulse Space footer
description: A warm off-white footer: a 40px newsletter heading with a short lede and a pill email field beside a light-up pill, three link columns under uppercase mono titles with 20px links that dim to 70% on hover, a row of mono legal links whose underlines sweep on hover, and an optional wordmark set huge across the full width at the foot.
notes: the form is plain HTML (action/method props); no JavaScript
the big wordmark is optional; it scales with the window width and is sized for a name of about seven capitals
name: impulsespace-footer

props.name: emailLabel
props.description: the email field's visible placeholder and accessible label

props.name: legal
props.description: the mono legal links at the foot

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the company's name, set huge across the foot; leave empty to skip
